sintesis.en: Energy prices have soared again since fighting between US and Iran resumed two weeks ago as conflict spreads across Middle East Iran has said it struck two tankers trying to pass through the strait of Hormuz under the escort of the US military as Donald Trump gathered his cabinet to discuss the stalling war and rising prices as midterm elections in the US loom. Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said on Friday that the “non-compliant oil tankers … were struck and brought to a halt, while four other oil tankers quickly changed course and returned to their previous positions”. The military body said the ships had tried to pass through the strait via an “undeclared route” and under US aerial escort.

titulo.es: Milei prohíbe la entrada a extranjeros que difundan "mensajes de odio" contra Argentina

sintesis.es: El gobierno de Javier Milei aprobó un decreto de urgencia que prohíbe el ingreso o permite la expulsión de extranjeros que promuevan discursos de odio contra el pueblo argentino o el país. La medida, que entrará en vigor de inmediato pero debe ser ratificada por el Parlamento, excluye explícitamente las críticas políticas o ideológicas. Sin embargo, su futuro es incierto en un contexto de tensiones diplomáticas y polémicas deportivas, como las críticas a la selección albiceleste tras su derrota en la final del Mundial de Fútbol 2026 frente a España.

titulo.es: FIFA retira el plan de Infantino para abrir los Mundiales a inversión privada tras masivo rechazo
titulo.en: FIFA scraps Infantino's plan to open World Cups to private investment after massive backlash

sintesis.es: La FIFA anunció la retirada de su propuesta 'FIFA Forward Enterprise', que buscaba vender participaciones comerciales de sus torneos, incluido el Mundial, a inversores privados. La decisión llegó tras una fuerte oposición de confederaciones como la UEFA y la CONCACAF, amenazas de boicot de federaciones europeas y exigencias de que su presidente Gianni Infantino compareciera ante el Parlamento Europeo. Infantino confirmó el desistimiento alegando que el plan había generado 'divisiones' dentro del fútbol mundial.
sintesis.en: FIFA announced it is abandoning its 'FIFA Forward Enterprise' proposal, which sought to sell commercial stakes in its tournaments, including the World Cup, to private investors. The decision followed strong opposition from confederations such as UEFA and CONCACAF, boycott threats from European federations, and demands for president Gianni Infantino to appear before the European Parliament. Infantino confirmed the withdrawal, saying the plan had 'created divisions' within world football.

titulo.es: New quantum gravity theory links entropy, dark energy, and life
titulo.en: New quantum gravity theory links entropy, dark energy, and life

sintesis.es: A new theoretical study offers a possible explanation for how the Universe can grow more complex without violating the second law of thermodynamics. Using a quantum gravity framework called Gravity from Entropy, mathematician Ginestra Bianconi found that the Universe’s total entropy may rise as space expands, even while entropy within each unit of volume falls. That decline could leave room for galaxies, stars, planets, and life to form locally amid an overall increase in cosmic entropy.

titulo.en: NASA, SpaceX Advance Wind Tunnel Tests for Starship Rocket
